paragraphs: Social Media Analyst with 4+ years of experience driving social media analytics, content performance, audience engagement, and campaign insights across Meta, Instagram, X, and LinkedIn. Skilled in social listening, paid social analysis, content strategy, competitive benchmarking, and performance reporting using Sprinklr, Hootsuite, Google Analytics, Meta Insights, and Excel.
Partners with marketing, creative, brand, HR, and paid media teams to translate social data into actionable recommendations that strengthen engagement, brand visibility, and campaign performance.
